summary: use_vars_plugins (2.11+) lets constructed inventory use host/group vars from vars plugins such as host_group_vars, running all vars plugins; implicit groups must be defined in earlier inventory for their group_vars to apply.
questions: How do I use group_vars and host_vars inside a constructed inventory?
Why aren't my group_vars available to constructed expressions?

answer_card.title: constructed use_vars_plugins
answer_card.answer_md: `use_vars_plugins` (default false, 2.11+): normally vars plugins run after inventory sources finish. Enabling this lets constructed read host/group vars from those plugins, including `host_group_vars`, which reads `host_vars/` and `group_vars/`. It runs **all** vars plugins. Implicit groups like `all` or `ungrouped` must be explicitly defined in an earlier inventory for their group_vars to apply.
